issue_context.title: disable/use default values for paste styles if no styles have been copied
issue_context.body:
Paste styles produces a weird state if no styles have been copied yet.

- Create a new element.
- Select paste styles.
- If it is a text elment or a multielement the app crashes. Otherwise, it pastes empty styles. Trying to change the background color of the element freezes the tab.
comments:

I’ll come up with a fix
